Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD

declare
 temp_catalog_no VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
 sZLotPos NUMBER:=0;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number := upper(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number);
 
 
 --This procedure validates the concatenated scan of catalog number and lot number.
 -- Check data identifiers
 
 IF :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number!='M' then 
 
 
 IF substr(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND -- catalog number (scanninng with the container ID)
 substr( :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number, 13, 2 ) = '&)' THEN -- lot number identifier
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number,1,12), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number := substr(temp_catalog_no,2);
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number,13);
 End If;
 
 ELSIF substr(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND substr( :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number, 12, 2 ) = '&)' then -- for catalog number without continer ID 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number,1,11), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number := temp_catalog_no;
 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number,12);
 End If;
 
 ELSE -- catalog scan only 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(:ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number, temp_catalog_no);
 If form_failure then
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_catalog_number := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number:= '';
 ---:s_bag_code_desc := '';
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 if length(temp_catalog_no)=10 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number :=substr(temp_catalog_no,2);
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no; 
 end if;
 
 END IF; 
END IF;

 
END;

procedure calc_new_expiry_date (p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_group in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_proc_date in date,
 p_new_expdate out date)
is
 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_c_code_scheme VARCHAR2(1) := name_in('GLOBAL.code_scheme'); 
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 select decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_proc_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_proc_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')),
 life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(p_proc_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))+(life_span / 24)),
 life_span_ind
 into p_new_expdate,temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_product_attributes
 where attrib_group = p_attr_group
 and attrib_code = p_attr_code
 and life_span is not null
 and life_span_ind is not null
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 AND valid_product_attributes.product_type 
 = ( SELECT product_type
 FROM valid_products WHERE

 new_expiry_date date;
 cursor c1 is select attrib_group, attrib_code, proc_date
